decision.observation: 9 mph, gear R, timer 29:41.615, red X lit. The reverse carried the car right back onto the gravel: it now sits on the centreline, nose up-frame, road curving up-left, white posts on both edges, red/white striped hut to the upper right.
decision.hypothesis: The reverse rejoin worked and the car is aligned with the track. Plain W should convert R -> 1 and roll it forward down the centreline without losing much speed.
decision.memory: Backing off a grass pin with a 1-2 s reverse, then plain W, is a proven rejoin sequence from either side of the road - it restored the car to the centreline at 9 mph here.
